title: Choose the landing page's structure
question: The Stamp Paper world is fixed; this choice is the page's composition. The roll dealt three structures, all built from real run figures.

options.label: Issue a run
options.lineage: a blank stamp paper with its printed fields
options.thesis: The first viewport is a stamp-paper sheet with blank fields: pick the portal and the scope, press Issue run, and you land in that console.
options.viewport: Green rail-coloured masthead with seal and nav; centre-left, one large stamp-paper sheet with a guilloché border, the headline set on it, two portal choices as the sheet's 'denomination' boxes and an Issue run button; the latest real run's serial and counts printed in its corner.
options.risk: Pre-filling a form on the landing page promises more than it does if the console does not carry the chosen portal through.

options.label: The register
options.thesis: The first viewport is the register of real runs: serial, portal, tenders read, kept, closing pages, each row openable in the console.
options.viewport: Headline and Open console across the top band; below it, a full-width ruled register of the six latest real runs with live serials, read/kept counts at poster scale on the newest row.
options.risk: A table above the fold reads as the app, not a pitch, to a first-time client.

options.label: Eight pages, one workbook
options.lineage: a stack of portal printouts stamped into one document
options.thesis: The portal's eight pages fan out on the left; a single validated workbook with 765 read and 101 kept sits on the right, the rosette between them.
options.viewport: Headline over a wide stage: eight thin numbered sheets fanned at left, the rosette at the centre fully drawn, one stamp-paper workbook at right with its counts and Open console under it.
options.risk: The fanned sheets are illustration; if they read as decoration the proof weakens.
